en: The bill, please, I'm leaving.
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café

es: Enseguida se la traigo.
en: I'll bring it right away. (polite)
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café

es: Quédese con el cambio, se lo merece.
en: Keep the change, you deserve it. (polite)
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café

es: Vuelva pronto, aquí siempre es bienvenido.
en: Come back soon, you're always welcome here. (polite)
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café

es: ¡Qué pena con usted!
en: I'm so sorry! (polite)
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café

es: ¡Qué pena con ustedes, de verdad!
en: I'm so sorry about this, really! (you all)
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café

es: ¡Bravo, Vale! ¡Qué manera de cantar!
en: Bravo, Vale! What a way to sing!
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café

es: ¡Qué bueno que viniste, Mariana!
en: I'm so glad you came, Mariana!
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café

es: ¡Ojalá nunca cierre este lugar!
en: I hope this place never closes!
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café

es: ¡Cuidado con la trompeta, que es prestada!
en: Careful with the trumpet, it's borrowed!
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café

es: ¡Silencio, que va a empezar el monólogo!
en: Quiet, the monologue is about to start! (you all)
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café

es: ¡No toquen el decorado, que todavía está húmedo!
en: Don't touch the set, it's still wet! (you all)
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café

es: ¡Qué ridículo hice en el escenario!
en: What a fool I made of myself on stage!
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café

es: ¡Qué vergüenza, me equivoqué en el verso!
en: How embarrassing, I got the line wrong!
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café

es: ¡Ni se te ocurra vender el café!
en: Don't you even think of selling the café! (to a friend)
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café

es: ¡Qué buen pan, Vale, está para chuparse los dedos!
en: What good bread, Vale, it's finger-licking good!
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café

es: ¡Qué bien suena esa sinfonía!
en: How good that symphony sounds!
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café

es: ¡Mira cuánta gente en la plaza, el barrio está en pleno auge!
en: Look how many people in the square, the neighbourhood is booming! (to a friend)
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café

es: Eso no lo sabía, Tomás, cuéntame más.
en: I didn't know that, Tomás, tell me more.
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café

es: Después te cuento, ahora hay que abrir.
en: I'll tell you later, now we have to open. (to a friend)
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café

es: Ahora mismo no puedo, estoy ensayando.
en: I can't right now, I'm rehearsing.
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café

es: Pues ensaya más despacio, que el vecino duerme.
en: Well rehearse more quietly, the neighbour is sleeping. (to a friend)
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café

es: De acuerdo, pero solo hasta las nueve.
en: Agreed, but only until nine.
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café

es: Me ayudas a colgar este cuadro, ¿sí?
en: Will you help me hang this painting, okay? (to a friend)
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café

es: Claro, ¿tienes un clavo?
en: Sure, do you have a nail? (to a friend)
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café

es: Mejor lo cuelgo yo, tú sostén la escalera.
en: Better I hang it, you hold the ladder. (to a friend)
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café

es: Si te caes, yo no vi nada.
en: If you fall, I didn't see anything. (to a friend)
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café

es: Hoy llovió todo el día y vino medio barrio a tomar café.
en: Today it rained all day and half the neighbourhood came for coffee.
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café

es: Cosa rara, cuando llueve el café se llena.
en: Funny thing, when it rains the café fills up.
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café

es: Pues que llueva siempre, entonces.
en: Well let it always rain, then.
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café

es: Eso dice Simón: que llueva, que llueva.
en: That's what Simón says: let it rain, let it rain.
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café

es: Qué raro que no haya dicho nada más hoy.
en: How odd that he hasn't said anything else today.
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café

es: Es que está esperando el momento justo.
en: It's that he's waiting for the right moment.
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café

es: ¿Saliste bien en el artículo nuevo de Mariana sobre el barrio?
en: Did you come off well in Mariana's new article about the neighbourhood? (to a friend)
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café

es: Todavía no lo leo, ¿sale bien parado el café?
en: I haven't read it yet, does the café come off well? (to a friend)
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café

es: Por suerte sí, y el crítico sale peor.
en: Luckily yes, and the critic comes out worse.
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café

es: Lamentablemente, todavía queda su reseña por responder.
en: Sadly, there's still his review to answer.
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café

es: Entonces escribámosla juntos esta noche.
en: Then let's write it together tonight.
theme: dialogue, replies and requests in the café
